posts.name: Phantom5613
posts.cooked:
In the most recent(to this writing) update to the OblivAeon Kickstarter, we got to see some images of the foil cards Fifth Anniversary Foil Hero Collection!

But that's not all we saw! We also managed to see something I don't think was leaked before:

http://tinyurl.com/hxpse5q (Sorry, I forgot how to make images appear in a post)

We now know FV Legacy's power!

Overwatch: You may either move an environment card in play to bottom of the environment deck, or one player may play a card.

Seems like a pretty awesome support power to me, it's right up Legacy's alley. :)

What's you guy's thoughts on this power? What do you think the other FV Promo member's powers gonna be? (I'd hazard a guess that some of them will focus on helping one another, much like Overwatch or some of the other super team promo heroes' powers)

Edit: Spellin' and spaces fixed. I think.

posts.name: Chaosmancer
posts.cooked:
MigrantP:

I think a Legacy playing two cards a turn can be a force to be reckoned with.

 

I… I didn't even see that… dang.

 

It all honesty though, I don't think we have a single "sub-par" Legacy Promo base power. Atomic Gaze is awesome, Gung-Ho is super Sweet, Galvanize could honestly be one of the best base powers in the entire game. It becomes a real struggle if you actually have to choose one in my opinion.

 

Discussing more of the team dynamic, it really is hard to say what we are going to see. It could end up being a lot of field management stuff, they are the premier super hero team, that would make them the best at responding to crisis situations and managing what is hitting the board and how bad things get. Alternatively, they could work like a super well oiled machine and just have a lot of supporting abilities that make other players do better.

UXM266:

 

Chaosmancer wrote:
[...] Atomic Gaze is awesome, [...]  
I read that as atomic Glaze at first, then immediately wanted a donut.But playing a second card? He's not the fastest hero to build up. 

 

Sure, it doesn't take a lot to build him up normally, but I know personally I often have to make a difficult choice with LEgacy of building up or doing things now. With this power you can do both, or get out combos that are really hard to set up much faster. Turn 1 get out motivational charge and legacy ring. Or Fortitude and LEad from the Front, Surge of Strength and Thokk, ect. Plus, you don' have to play the card yourself, or you could even patrol the environment and remove something nasty as a base power.

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
I prefer Gaze, Gung Ho, or Solve Puzzle to Overwatch, but it is a good card.  

It is really powerful, and I typically use it to play the cards you always want to play but never get around to because you are setting up.  Thokk and Bolster Allies are obvious cards that get played more with this power (with your normal card play because of the draw), since they keep your hand size, otherwise his benefit tends to be short lived as you run out of cards.

It is well balanced with the other innates in my opinion, but everyone has their preference.
